test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 19 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Find a single discount (approximately) equal to three consecutive discounts of 7%, 10% and 15%.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net factor = (1 − 0.07)(1 − 0.10)(1 − 0.15)

= 0.93 × 0.90 × 0.85 = 0.71145

Equivalent discount = 1 − 0.71145 = 0.28855

≈ 28.85%

**∴ Answer ≈ 28.5%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Three successive discounts = 7%, 10%, 15%

**Formula used:**

Equivalent discount = 1 − (1 − d₁)(1 − d₂)(1 − d₃)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Remaining price = 0.93 × 0.90 × 0.85 = 0.71145

⇒ Equivalent discount = 1 − 0.71145 = 0.28855

⇒ = 28.85%

⇒ ≈ 28.5%

**∴ The correct answer is approximately 28.9%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount

Multiply remaining percentages stepwise

Equivalent Discount

Single discount giving same effect

Approximation

Round off final percentage as required

Key Insight

Never add successive discounts directly
